title: Chapter 16
text: ACKNOWLEDGMENTS Well, this has been another hard year. If you’re reading this, I’m just glad you’re still around. I’d like to thank my agents Jennifer Jackson and Michael Curry, my editor Lee Harris, and the rest of the Tordotcom/Tor Publishing Group team: Editorial: Matt Rusin Marketing: Michael Dudding, Eileen Lawrence, and Sam Friedlander in Social Marketing Publicity: Desirae Friesen Managing editor Rafal Gibek, production manager Steven Bucsok, and production editor Megan Kiddoo Copy editor Amanda Hong, proofreader Madeline Grigg, and cold reader Ed Chapman Cover artist Jaime Jones, cover designer Christine Foltzer, and interior designer Heather Saunders OceanofPDF.com
